description: A group of filter conditions combined with a boolean operator. Groups can be nested to form arbitrary boolean expression trees (AND/OR/NOT).

operator.description: The boolean operator used to combine the children of this group.
operator.name: BooleanOperator

enum.name: OR
enum.description: At least one child must match.

not.description: When true, negates this entire group. When null (default) or false, the group is not negated.

children.description: The child filters combined by this group's operator. Each child is either a leaf filter (e.g. ColumnSingleValueQueryFilter) or a nested FilterGroup.
